title: Plan for Store Failure
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Plan for Store Failure.
learning_objectives: Explain plan for store failure using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for plan for store failure
Assess failure and operational limits of plan for store failure
concepts_covered: Fail-open means a request is permitted if the store errors; that preserves availability but removes rate protection during the outage.
AllowAt returns true on Store.Take error; Remaining returns zero on error.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary

Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
